title: Who-Is broadcast with bounded device range
purpose: Improve unconfirmed-service depth by using a broadcast Who-Is with small low/high device-instance range bytes rather than a payload-free shell.
expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP device should parse Original-Broadcast-NPDU and route the APDU as an unconfirmed Who-Is request with a short bounded range-style payload.
constraints_preserved: APDU first octet uses unconfirmed-request PDU type 0x10.
Unconfirmed service choice 0x08 is used for Who-Is from the visible operation catalog excerpt.
issue_safety_notes: This is a bounded broadcast discovery seed and does not use any issue crash pattern.
